Agent Name: Planner
Step Number: 5
Reason for Mistake: The Planner misinterpreted the sources by conflating the distributor (Buena Vista Distribution Company) with the production company. Despite earlier evidence and snippets clearly stating both films were produced by Walt Disney Productions and released by Buena Vista Distribution, the Planner incorrectly concluded the production company was Buena Vista. This over-reliance on IMDb company credits (which emphasized distribution) and failure to reconcile with Wikipedia/TCM/Disney data led to the wrong final answer.
